title: GitHub - SoftwareRenderer/MIKE: MIKE: Integrated Kanban Environment
excerpt: MIKE: Integrated Kanban Environment. Contribute to SoftwareRenderer/MIKE development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
MIKE is a LLM harness that streamlines software development work. It integrates strong sandbox isolation (via gVisor) and securely supports custom extensions (via iframe sandbox/wazero). It also features a Progressive Web App optimized to improve usability on spotty networks. Works with llama.cpp and inference providers that support the OpenAI Chat Completions API.

Note

The API and Extension surfaces are still being solidified. No stable API/Extension interfaces will be guaranteeed until version 1.0.

Quick Start

Prerequisite:

  • docker or podman must be installed
  1. Generate a secure key
openssl rand -hex 32
  1. Create a .env file, containing the secure key:
MIKE_ENCRYPTION_KEY=secure_key
  1. Use docker / podman:
podman run -p 3000:3000 --env-file .env --privileged docker.io/softwarerenderer/mike:latest

Note that privileged access is only needed in this containerized Quick Start in order to support nested containers.

  1. Navigate to https://localhost:3000

  2. You will be prompted to pair a Passkey using a code provided after starting the application.

  • Firefox on Linux: As of 2026-10-10, there is limited support for Passkeys.

Manual Setup

Prerequisites:

  • Podman
  • gVisor
  • git
  1. Download the latest release
  2. Set the encryption key and run:
MIKE_ENCRYPTION_KEY=testkey ./mike-server -port 3000
  1. Continue from step 4 in the Quick Start section.

Development

Prerequisites, in addition to Manual Setup:

  • Go
  • npm
  1. Build frontend
cd frontend && npm run build
  1. Run backend

Navigate back to the main directory, then run

MIKE_ENCRYPTION_KEY=testkey go run .

If hosting beyond localhost: This example listens on all network interfaces.

MIKE_ENCRYPTION_KEY=testkey go run . -listen 0.0.0.0 -allowed-hosts your.hostname.com
  1. Continue from step 4 in the Quick Start section.

Feature Highlights

In additon to common features such as automatic context compaction, Skills, AGENTS.md, MCP, and background tasks, MIKE also includes a few "invisible" improvements that help maintain smooth operation:

  • RAM Management: Parallel tasks means that more builds and tests are running. To avoid out-of-memory errors, MIKE monitors usage and automatically pauses/resumes tasks.
  • RESTful Web API: This enables programmatic control over the board state, and has built in security controls such as enforced encryption, Bearer tokens, rate limits, and authorized hosts.
  • Upstream error handling: Potential issues related to the inference provider or model such as failed tool calls, loops, crashes, or rate limits are always recoverable and don't result in lost progress.
  • Enterprise Readiness: Administrators have control over deployed configuration, and can prevent changes such as installation of extensions and inference providers.
